# Pixel Task List

An offline, pixel-style task list built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

## Features

- Add tasks with the input field (id `todo-input`) and Add button (id `todo-add`).
- Blank or whitespace-only input is ignored.
- Total task count shown in `#todo-total`, incomplete count in `#remaining` (both start at 0).
- Each task gets increasing numeric IDs: text span `#todo-text-N`, checkbox `#todo-check-N`, delete button `#todo-delete-N`.
- Toggling a checkbox updates the incomplete count; deleting a task removes it and updates both counts.
- All state is kept in memory — no storage or network requests.

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. Type a task and press Enter or click Add. Use the checkbox to mark done; click Delete to remove.

## Files

- `index.html` — structure
- `styles.css` — pixel-art theme, responsive layout
- `app.js` — in-memory state and DOM logic

## Notes

- No external assets, libraries, or server code.
- Keyboard accessible: all controls are focusable and labeled.
- Works from 360px width upward.
